title: Azusawa Kohane — Warm Camping Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: A week after the camping trip.
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, we can head over to practice once we're done drinking these.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, can I have a minute before we do...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I finished putting together the digital album for our camping trip.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Would you like to take a look before we start practice?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A digital album? Like the one you made for Haruka, Minori and me after we went to PXL?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I had my dad help me with that one, but I made it all on my own this time!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, now I see why you wanted us to send you any photos we took during our trip.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, especially since our trip was all about us envisioning the same thing as we sing a song.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So I thought it'd be nice to have something that can remind us of what we saw and experienced together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa... The ones you took in continuous mode look pretty much like a video.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, this is awesome!
This makes it so easy to remember what we thought or felt at any particular point!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And just the sheer number of photos... You took so many different kinds too, Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right?! Everything from landscapes to these little birdies... She captured us really well too. Oh, here's one of me cooking. I look like I mean business♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I thought about using just the ones where we're smiling at first, but I feel like this gives us a much better picture of what happened during our trip.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, here's one of An looking really depressed after not being able to figure out how to pitch that tent.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, I figured out that you had to follow a certain order to stick the poles in, didn't I?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you didn't remember the actual order, so that doesn't really count.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm really glad you suggested that we divide up roles, Shinonome. That really helped us out a lot in the end.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, and sounding like you knew what you were doing helped too...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
When's this one from...?
Akito seems very worried...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that happened while you were chopping vegetables.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was hoping to get a picture of each of us prepping for dinner, but I couldn't resist taking this one... The expression on Shinonome's face was so priceless.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yeah, you're right.
His brow's almost as furled as Toya's!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Akito, you worrywart!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Quiet, you.
Wouldn't you also be worried if someone was holding a knife for the first time?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I apologize for making you feel that way. I promise to be more careful so that you can be at ease next time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks, but it's not like we're gonna be using knives all that much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And this one has Azusawa in it... And Shiraishi in front of her, I think...? You look mad for some reason, Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ah, that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I took that one.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: An was sneaking in a few bites but got caught by Kohane and then she got mad at her. It was too funny to not take a picture.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It wasn't funny and you didn't have to do that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe... Oh, look.
It's us picking those wild plants.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That was a really long album!
But really good too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for making that for us, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you for going through it with me! I'm really glad I made it now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It certainly helped us remember everything that happened and all that we gained during our trip.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we start practice while that's still fresh in our minds?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm glad they like it so much...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I hope we get more chances to take trips like that in the future, together.)
